title: Understanding Kernel Functions
text: A kernel function is used in KDE to estimate the probability density function of a random variable. It is important to know that the kernel function is symmetric and integrates to $$1$$ over its entire range.

hintAnswer: A kernel function has an area under the curve of $$1$$.
title: Properties of Kernel Functions
text: Which of the following is a property of a kernel function?
choices: A kernel function has to be differentiable across its domain.
A kernel function has to be Gaussian.
A kernel function has an area under the curve of $$1$$.
